diagnostics.message: :resource.null_resource.wait_for_cluster: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this is redundant — already implied by attribute references
null_resource.wait_for_cluster already references aws_eks_cluster.this.endpoint in its provisioner environment, so its explicit dependency on the cluster duplicates that implicit ordering.

aws_eks_node_group.workers already depends on var.ng_depends_on transitively through random_pet.node_groups, which has that explicit dependency; the node group's own explicit dependency duplicates this ordering.

aws_autoscaling_group.workers can launch bootstrap instances before workers_AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy is attached. Wait for the attachment so the worker role has EKS node permissions at boot and retains them until the group is destroyed.
aws_autoscaling_group.workers can launch instances before workers_AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy is attached, racing the permissions needed by the node networking plugin when this attachment is enabled.
aws_autoscaling_group.workers can launch instances before workers_AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly is attached, racing the registry permissions needed to pull node system images.

aws_autoscaling_group.workers_launch_template can launch bootstrap instances before workers_AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy is attached. Wait for the attachment so node permissions exist before boot and remain until the group is destroyed.

aws_autoscaling_group.workers_launch_template can launch instances before workers_AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy is attached, racing permissions needed by the node networking plugin when this attachment is enabled.
aws_autoscaling_group.workers_launch_template can launch instances before workers_AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly is attached, racing registry permissions needed to pull node system images.
